content.content:
1	# Server TypeScript migration (Phase 3)
2	
3	Goal: convert every first-party .js file under server/ and index.js to TypeScript, one batch (directory) at a time. The vendored code in server/libs and all files under test/ stay as they are.
4	
5	## Rules (apply to every batch)
6	1. At the end of every batch `npm run build:server` must report 0 "error TS" and `npm test` must show 356 passing, 0 failing. Never end a session with a red build.
7	2. Do not edit, skip or delete any test. Do not change files outside the batch unless a type error in the batch cannot be fixed otherwise; list any such change in the Log below.
8	3. Runtime behaviour must not change. Do not fix bugs. When types expose a bug, keep the behaviour, add a `NOTE:` comment at that line and add one line to the Bugs section below.
9	4. No `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, no `@ts-nocheck`, no `@ts-expect-error`. Use `unknown` and narrow it. Every type assertion (`as`) needs a one-line comment.
10	5. Module style (copied from Phase 1 and 2): local modules use `import X = require('./X')` and `export = X`, so existing require() callers, tests and sinon stubs keep working. Third-party packages with a default export use `import x from 'pkg'`.
11	6. Shared types live next to the data they describe (see server/providers/types.ts). Add a types.ts in the directory when two or more files share a type.
12	7. Convert with `git mv X.js X.ts` so history is kept. Keep JSDoc descriptions and drop JSDoc type annotations that the signature now carries.
13	8. At the end of each batch: update the Progress table, commit with the message `phase3 batch N: <directory>`, and stop.
14	
15	## Progress
16	| Batch | Directory | Files | Status |
17	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
18	| 1 | server/utils (all subfolders) | 46 | done |
19	| 2 | server/objects (all subfolders) | 18 | done |
20	| 3 | server/models | 25 | 3a done, 3b done (QueryFindOptions kept, see Known deviations) |
21	| 4 | server/auth and server/routers | 6 | done |
22	| 5 | server/managers | 18 | done |
23	| 6 | server/scanner | 13 | done |
24	| 7 | server/controllers (remaining 22) | 22 | todo |
25	| 8 | server/migrations | 15 | todo |
26	| 9 | server top-level files (Logger, Database, Auth, SocketAuthority, Watcher, Server) and index.js | 7 | todo |
27	| 10 | Packaging: package.json scripts, Dockerfile and anything else that references a .js entry point | 0 | todo |
28	
29	Already done in Phase 2: server/finders, server/providers, server/controllers/SearchController.
30	
31	## Bugs found (not fixed)
32	Each has a `NOTE:` comment at the line.
33	- server/utils/generators/opmlGenerator.ts: reads `podcast.itunesPageUrl` but the Podcast model field is `itunesPageURL`, so the OPML outline never gets an `htmlUrl`.
34	- server/utils/podcastUtils.ts `extractImage`: xml2js puts `<image>` in an array, so `channel.image.url` is always undefined and the RSS `<image><url>` is never used (always falls back to `itunes:image`).
35	- server/utils/podcastUtils.ts `extractEpisodeData`: the second `media:content` find does not require a url, so an audio `media:content` without a url makes `enclosure.url.trim()` throw.
36	- server/utils/scandir.ts `groupFileItemsIntoLibraryItemDirs`: a media file in the folder root is stored as a string group; if a directory has the same name, `.push` is called on that string and throws (2 places).
37	- server/utils/parsers/parseFullName.ts: `fixCase !== 'undefined'` compares with the string 'undefined' instead of using typeof, so that part of the check is always true.
38	- server/utils/parsers/parseFullName.ts `fixParsedNameCase`: the suffix check indexes `namePartLabels[j]` (word index) instead of `namePartLabels[i]` (label index).
39	- server/utils/comicBookExtractors.ts `CbzComicBookExtractor.open`: `getBuffer()` can return null, which is passed to `Archive.open` unchecked (the class is not used by `createComicBookExtractor` at the moment).
40	- server/utils/migrations/dbMigration.ts `handleOldLibraries`: maps `oldDbIdMap.libraries[library.oldLibraryId]`, but the Library model has no `oldLibraryId` (it was just written to `extraData`), so the key is "undefined" and old library ids in users' `librariesAccessible` are mapped to undefined and dropped.
41	- server/objects/files/LibraryFile.ts `setDataFromPath`: `getFileTimestampsWithIno` returns `false` when stat fails; the file is then created with `ino` undefined and no size/timestamps, and no error is reported.
42	- server/auth/TokenManager.ts `rotateTokensForSession`: when the conditional update hits 0 rows and the session row has been deleted in the meantime, `findOne` returns null and `updatedSession.refreshToken` throws.
43	- server/auth/OidcAuthStrategy.ts `verifyCallback`: when no user matches and auto-register is off, `user.isActive` is read on null and throws a TypeError, so the intended 'User not active or not found' error is never thrown (the login still fails, the log shows the TypeError).
44	- server/routers/ApiRouter.ts `getUserListeningStatsHelpers`: reads `s.lastUpdate`, but PlaybackSession has no `lastUpdate` (it is `updatedAt`), so `items[id].lastUpdate` is always undefined.
45	- server/models/Collection.ts `getOldCollectionsJsonExpanded`: the permission-filtered books are assigned to `this.books`, which in this static method is the Collection class, not the collection `c`; `c.toOldJSONExpanded()` then uses the unfiltered `c.books`, so users with tag or explicit-content restrictions get every book of a collection they can see (and the class gets a stray `books` property).
46	- server/models/Library.ts `getMaxDisplayOrder`: `this.max('displayOrder') || 0` applies `|| 0` to the promise, which is always truthy, so with no libraries it resolves to null instead of 0.
47	- server/models/Author.ts `getAllLibraryItemsForAuthor`: `author.books` is read without checking that `findByPk` found the author, so an unknown author id throws a TypeError.
48	- server/models/Feed.ts `updateFeedForEntity`: when the library item, collection or series of the feed no longer exists, `getExpandedById` returns null and `getFeedObjFor...` throws a TypeError before the try block (3 places), so the caller gets an exception instead of null.
49	- server/models/Playlist.ts `checkHasMediaItem`: without an episodeId it reads `pmi.mediaItem.libraryItem.id` for every item, but a podcast episode media item has no `libraryItem` (it is on `episode.podcast`), so it throws a TypeError for playlists that contain episodes.
50	- server/models/PodcastEpisode.ts `createFromRssPodcastEpisode`: RSS chapters can have `end: null` (the RSS parser types them so), and they are stored in the `chapters` column, which everything else reads as chapters with a numeric end.
51	- server/models/LibraryItem.ts `saveMetadataFile`: the podcast branch writes `asin: mediaExpanded.asin`, but Podcast has no asin, so it is always undefined (and left out of metadata.json).
52	- server/models/User.ts `checkCanAccessLibraryItem`: `libraryItem.media.metadata?.explicit` reads a property of the old models; Book and Podcast have no `metadata`, so that half of the explicit check is always false.
53	- server/models/Session.ts `refreshToken` (with server/auth/TokenManager.ts `createTokensAndSession`, `rotateTokensForSession`): the column is NOT NULL, but TokenManager writes `generateRefreshToken` results, which are null when signing fails; the create/update then fails validation and throws instead of reporting the signing error.
54	- server/managers/NotificationManager.ts `onTest`: calls `triggerNotification('onTest')` without event data; `getApprisePayload` then reads the template variables from undefined and throws a TypeError for the default onTest templates (`{{version}}`). onTest is not called anywhere at the moment.
55	- server/managers/CronManager.ts `checkUpdatePodcastCron`: the log title falls back to `libraryItem.media.metadata?.title`, an old-model property; Podcast has no `metadata`, so the fallback is always undefined.
56	- server/managers/RssFeedManager.ts `checkFeedRequiresUpdate`: when the library item, collection or series of a feed no longer exists, `getEntity` returns null and the next read throws a TypeError (2 places); `getFeed`: when `updateFeedForEntity` returns null, `feed.buildXml` throws a TypeError.
57	- server/managers/PodcastManager.ts `createPodcastsFromFeedUrls`: when `getFileTimestampsWithIno` fails (returns false), the library item is created with `ino` undefined and the timestamps 0; when the feed title is empty or not a string, `sanitizeFilename` returns false, so the podcast path ends in "/false" and `relPath` is false.
58	- server/managers/CoverSearchManager.ts `startSearch`: on a failed search it calls `onError(error.message)`, but onError takes (provider, errorMessage), so the client gets the message as the provider and an undefined error.
59	- server/managers/MigrationManager.ts constructor: the default `configPath = global.configPath` reads a global that is never set (the global is `ConfigPath`); Database passes the path, so the default is not used.
60	- server/scanner/MediaProbeData.ts `setData`: prober accepts a file with only a video stream; `audio_stream` is then null and the reads of `this.audioStream` throw a TypeError, which prober.probe returns as the error (so the AudioFileScanner "no audio stream" message is not used for such files).
61	- server/scanner/AudioFileScanner.ts `getTrackAndDiscNumberFromFilename`: reads `author` and `series` from the filename metadata, which has `authors` and `seriesName`, so the author and series are never removed from the filename; `partbasename.replace(publishedYear)` has no replacement, so the year is replaced with the string "undefined".
62	- server/scanner/PodcastScanner.ts `saveMetadataFile`: writes `asin: libraryItem.media.asin`, but Podcast has no asin, so it is always undefined (same as LibraryItem `saveMetadataFile`).
63	- server/scanner/LibraryItemScanner.ts `getLibraryItemScanData`: when `getFileTimestampsWithIno` fails (returns false), the scan data gets `ino` undefined and the timestamps 0.
64	- server/scanner/Scanner.ts `quickMatchLibraryItem`: `PodcastFinder.search` returns null for a podcast without a title, and `results.length` then throws a TypeError.
65	- server/scanner/LibraryScanner.ts `scanLibrary`: when a library item is removed while the scan runs, `getExpandedById` returns null and the null is pushed to the updated items and emitted to clients (`items_updated`).
66	
67	## Log
68	### Batch 1: server/utils (46 files, all converted, none skipped)
69	- New type files: `server/utils/types.ts` (shared utils types, `declare global` for the `global.*` values used in utils, and typed views of untyped vendored libs/models), `server/utils/parsers/types.ts`, `server/utils/queries/types.ts`, and `server/utils/ssrf-req-filter.d.ts` (ssrf-req-filter has no types; tsconfig excludes `*.d.ts`, so it is pulled in with a `/// <reference>` from `server/utils/types.ts`).
70	- devDependencies added (rule 10): `@types/express`, `@types/xml2js`, `@types/uuid`. They were already in node_modules as extraneous packages; `npm install` also pruned the other extraneous ones locally (`@types/passport`, `@types/cookie-parser`, `@types/express-session`, `@types/passport-strategy` ...), so later batches must add those to devDependencies when they need them.
71	- No files outside server/utils were changed (apart from package.json/package-lock.json and this file). No tests were changed.
72	- Module style: every module now ends in `export = <object/class/function>`. Modules that used `module.exports.x = ...` export one object literal with the same keys; checked that no utils module is in a require cycle, so assembling the export object at the end is safe. Internal `this.x()` / `module.exports.x()` calls go through that object, so sinon stubs on exports keep working. Compared `Object.keys`/`typeof` of every compiled module against HEAD: identical, except `parseFullName` is now a `function` declaration (needed for overloads) instead of an arrow function, so it has a `prototype`.
73	- Typed views for untyped JS (each a single commented `as` where the module is required): `FsExtra` for libs/fsExtra (its fs API is built at runtime), `ArchiverFactory` for libs/archiver, `SortInstance` for libs/fastSort, the fuse.js constructor in podcastUtils, ffprobe in prober, libarchive in comicBookExtractors.
74	- `TypedDatabase` (utils/types.ts): the JS models override `Model.init` with a different signature, so TypeScript rejects their static query methods (`findAll`, `count`, ...). Files that query cast `require('../../Database')` to `TypedDatabase` (same object; model getters still read lazily). It also types `sequelize` as set and `libraryFilterData`. Batch 3 (models) should make this unnecessary.
75	- Model associations (`book.libraryItem`, `series.bookSeries`, `mediaProgress.mediaItem`, ...) and JSON columns (`user.permissions`, `user.extraData`, `playbackSession.mediaMetadata`) are not declared on the JS models; the queries describe the loaded rows locally and cast once per query result. Sequelize's types are stricter than what it accepts at runtime (arrays of where options, `limit: null`, `[literal]` order items, a single nested include object, `distinct` on findAll, `limit` on count); those option objects use `QueryFindOptions` or are cast at the call with a comment.
76	- Behaviour-neutral code changes made for typing: `new Date() - n` became `new Date().valueOf() - n` (same coercion); a few repeated reads were pulled into a commented local (`permissions`, `mediaMetadata`, `models`); `getMediaGroupQuery` in libraryItemsBookFilters writes properties through a `mediaWhereHash` alias of the same object; `libraryFilters.getFilterData` replaces its sets with arrays through a typed alias of the same object; zipHelpers no longer requires express at runtime (it was only used for a JSDoc type); dbMigration no longer destructures the unused `QueryInterface` value from sequelize.
77	- JSDoc in not yet converted JS files that points at typedefs which moved (`import('../utils/fileUtils').FilePathItem`, `import('../utils/podcastUtils').RssPodcast*`, `import('./parseEbookMetadata').EBookFileScanData`) now resolves to `any` in those JS files; point them at `server/utils/types.ts`, `podcastUtils.ts` or `parsers/types.ts` when those files are converted.
78	- Incremental tsc crash: changing `server/utils/types.ts` (its `declare global` block) makes `tsc` crash with `Debug Failure. False expression` in `getSpecifierForModuleSymbol` while re-emitting signatures of JS files. A clean build works; fix with `rm dist-server/.tsbuildinfo`.
79	- Result: `npm run build:server` reports 0 `error TS`; `npm test` 356 passing, 0 failing.
80	
81	### Batch 1 fixes (after independent review)
82	- abmetadataGenerator: restored the original `validated.series?.length` truthiness check (the batch had changed it to `Array.isArray(...) && ...length`); `series` is now typed `unknown[]` instead of using an `as`.
83	- Class fields declared without an initialiser in comicBookExtractors, utils/index (ValidationError, NotFoundError), rateLimiterFactory and longTimeout compiled to `field;` lines that created own properties set to undefined. They are now `declare` fields (rule 12) and compile to nothing, as in the JavaScript.
84	- Tried `"useDefineForClassFields": false` in tsconfig.server.json first and reverted it: it changed the compiled output of 21 files, including about 10 JS files that are not converted yet (ApiCacheManager, Database, Logger, TokenManager, MigrationManager, BinaryManager, User, DeviceInfo, ServerSettings, BookScanner), where real field initialisers move into the constructor body after parameter defaults. ApiCacheManager's `new LRUCache(this.defaultCacheOptions)` default then reads undefined and throws (348 passing, 1 failing).
85	
86	### Batch 2 and 4: server/objects, server/auth, server/routers (24 files, all converted, none skipped)
87	- New type files: `server/objects/types.ts` (`FileMetadataJSON`, `AudioChapter`, `TaskString`, and `DateAndTime`, a typed view of the minified vendored libs/dateAndTime used by objects and ApiRouter) and `server/auth/types.ts` (`declare global`: `Express.User` extends the User model so `req.user` is typed, and `var RouterBasePath`; `PassportDone`, `JwtPayload`).
88	- devDependencies added (rule 10): `@types/passport` (passport.use/unuse and `req.user`), `@types/express-session` (`req.session` in OidcAuthStrategy).
89	- No files outside the batch were changed (apart from package.json/package-lock.json and this file). No tests were changed.
90	- Class fields: every field the JS assigned in the constructor or later (none were JS class fields) is a `declare` field (rule 12), so the classes compile to the same constructor bodies. The JS static field initialisers (`DeviceInfo.stringFields`, `ServerSettings.patchableSettingsKeys`, `TokenManager.TokenSecret`) stay normal static fields. `Task.failedAt` and `TrackProgressMonitor.currentTrackProgress`, set outside the constructor, are declared too.
91	- Fields the JS JSDoc typed as non-null but initialised to null (`AudioFile.metadata`/`metaTags`, `LibraryFile.metadata`, `EBookFile.metadata`, `PodcastEpisodeDownload.rssPodcastEpisode`/`libraryItem`/`url`) keep the non-null type with a commented `null as unknown as T` in the constructor; other null-initialised fields are typed `T | null`.
92	- Inputs of the constructors (stored JSON) are typed as the toJSON shape (`AudioFileData`, `LibraryFileData`, `NotificationData`, `PlaybackSessionData`, `ServerSettingsData` = `Partial<toJSON> & { storeCoverWithBook?, storeMetadataWithBook? }`, ...). `FileMetadata.toJSON` and `LibraryFile.toJSON` cast their result to the non-null shape the JS models expect (`LibraryFileObject` in models/LibraryItem).
93	- `global.ServerSettings` (declared in utils/types.ts from `ServerSettings['toJSON']`) is now fully typed.
94	- ApiRouter: the JS controllers type `req` as their own `RequestWithUser`, which express's `RequestHandler` does not accept, so `this.router` is typed `ApiRouterApp` (express app whose get/post/patch/delete take handlers with open parameters) with one commented cast at `express()`. The route lines are unchanged.
95	- `TypedDatabase` casts (as in batch 1) in TokenManager and ApiRouter. TokenManager also types the session rows as `SessionRow` (the JS Session model does not declare `refreshToken`); ApiRouter adds `getPlaybackSessions(where): Promise<PlaybackSession[]>` to its Database view (it returns false only before Database.init).
96	- Compared the compiled output of all 24 files with the JS compiled at 7f280c67 (comments stripped, printed with the TypeScript printer): AudioTrack and TrackProgressMonitor are identical, LocalAuthStrategy identical apart from quote style. All other differences are listed here:
97	  - Module style: `const { a } = require('x')` / `require('x').a` became `import x = require('x')` plus `const { a } = x` / `const a = x.a` after the imports (still destructured at module load, now after the other requires of the file; none of the destructured modules is in a require cycle with the file that destructures it, so they are fully loaded either way). Typed views are `const fs = fsExtra`, `const date = dateAndTime`, `const Database = DatabaseModule` (same objects).
98	  - OidcAuthStrategy: `const { Request, Response } = require('express')` (only used for JSDoc; both values were undefined) became `import type`, so this module no longer requires express at runtime. `axios` is a default import (`axios_1.default.get`, the same axios object; rule 5).
99	  - Local aliases of the same object, so dynamic keys type check (`this[key]` / `payload[key]` read and written through `self` / `values` / `newValues` / `existingValues` / `jsonValues` / `other`): FileMetadata `update`, `setData`; AudioMetaTags `toJSON` (`for (const key in this)` became `for (const key in self)`), `updateData`, `isEqual`; AudioFile `updateFromScan`, `mimeType` (`AudioMimeType[format]` became `mimeTypes[format]`); DeviceInfo `construct`, `toJSON`, `update`; Notification `update`; EmailSettings `update`; ServerSettings `update`.
100	  - OidcAuthStrategy: `req.query.x` became `query.x` with `const query = req.query` at the start of `generatePkce` and `getAuthorizationUrl` (before the try; `req.query` is a plain property); `req.session[sessionKey]` became `session[sessionKey]` with `const session = req.session`; `client.issuer.end_session_endpoint` (read twice) became `issuer.end_session_endpoint` with `const issuer = client.issuer`.
101	  - ApiRouter `getUserListeningStatsHelpers`: `listeningSessions.forEach(...)` became `sessionsForStats.forEach(...)` with `const sessionsForStats = listeningSessions`.
102	  - Casts on expressions (`(await findOne(...)) as SessionRow`, `(session.updatedAt || session.startedAt) as number | null`, `(this.timeListening as number) += ...`) only add parentheses in the output.
103	- Non-null assertions (`!`, each with a comment): `FileMetadata.filenameNoExt`, OidcAuthStrategy `handleMobileRedirect` (`openIdAuthSession.get(state)!`, `has(state)` is checked just before).
104	- Result: `npm run build:server` reports 0 `error TS`; `npm test` 356 passing, 0 failing.
105	
106	### Batch 3a: server/models (25 files, all converted, none skipped)
107	- File count: 25 `.js` files under server/models (no subfolders), as the Progress table says. New type file: `server/models/types.ts` (JSON column shapes, the model registry, `UpdateValues`).
108	- devDependencies added (rule 10): `@types/jsonwebtoken` (ApiKey requires the npm `jsonwebtoken` package, which has no types; TokenManager uses the vendored libs/jsonwebtoken).

# Server TypeScript migration (Phase 3)

Goal: convert every first-party .js file under server/ and index.js to TypeScript, one batch (directory) at a time. The vendored code in server/libs and all files under test/ stay as they are.

## Rules (apply to every batch)
1. At the end of every batch `npm run build:server` must report 0 "error TS" and `npm test` must show 356 passing, 0 failing. Never end a session with a red build.
2. Do not edit, skip or delete any test. Do not change files outside the batch unless a type error in the batch cannot be fixed otherwise; list any such change in the Log below.
3. Runtime behaviour must not change. Do not fix bugs. When types expose a bug, keep the behaviour, add a `NOTE:` comment at that line and add one line to the Bugs section below.
4. No `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, no `@ts-nocheck`, no `@ts-expect-error`. Use `unknown` and narrow it. Every type assertion (`as`) needs a one-line comment.
5. Module style (copied from Phase 1 and 2): local modules use `import X = require('./X')` and `export = X`, so existing require() callers, tests and sinon stubs keep working. Third-party packages with a default export use `import x from 'pkg'`.
6. Shared types live next to the data they describe (see server/providers/types.ts). Add a types.ts in the directory when two or more files share a type.
7. Convert with `git mv X.js X.ts` so history is kept. Keep JSDoc descriptions and drop JSDoc type annotations that the signature now carries.
8. At the end of each batch: update the Progress table, commit with the message `phase3 batch N: <directory>`, and stop.

## Progress
| Batch | Directory | Files | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | server/utils (all subfolders) | 46 | done |
| 2 | server/objects (all subfolders) | 18 | done |
| 3 | server/models | 25 | 3a done, 3b done (QueryFindOptions kept, see Known deviations) |
| 4 | server/auth and server/routers | 6 | done |
| 5 | server/managers | 18 | done |
| 6 | server/scanner | 13 | done |
| 7 | server/controllers (remaining 22) | 22 | todo |
| 8 | server/migrations | 15 | todo |
| 9 | server top-level files (Logger, Database, Auth, SocketAuthority, Watcher, Server) and index.js | 7 | todo |
| 10 | Packaging: package.json scripts, Dockerfile and anything else that references a .js entry point | 0 | todo |

Already done in Phase 2: server/finders, server/providers, server/controllers/SearchController.

## Bugs found (not fixed)
Each has a `NOTE:` comment at the line.
- server/utils/generators/opmlGenerator.ts: reads `podcast.itunesPageUrl` but the Podcast model field is `itunesPageURL`, so the OPML outline never gets an `htmlUrl`.
- server/utils/podcastUtils.ts `extractImage`: xml2js puts `<image>` in an array, so `channel.image.url` is always undefined and the RSS `<image><url>` is never used (always falls back to `itunes:image`).
- server/utils/podcastUtils.ts `extractEpisodeData`: the second `media:content` find does not require a url, so an audio `media:content` without a url makes `enclosure.url.trim()` throw.
- server/utils/scandir.ts `groupFileItemsIntoLibraryItemDirs`: a media file in the folder root is stored as a string group; if a directory has the same name, `.push` is called on that string and throws (2 places).
- server/utils/parsers/parseFullName.ts: `fixCase !== 'undefined'` compares with the string 'undefined' instead of using typeof, so that part of the check is always true.
- server/utils/parsers/parseFullName.ts `fixParsedNameCase`: the suffix check indexes `namePartLabels[j]` (word index) instead of `namePartLabels[i]` (label index).
- server/utils/comicBookExtractors.ts `CbzComicBookExtractor.open`: `getBuffer()` can return null, which is passed to `Archive.open` unchecked (the class is not used by `createComicBookExtractor` at the moment).
- server/utils/migrations/dbMigration.ts `handleOldLibraries`: maps `oldDbIdMap.libraries[library.oldLibraryId]`, but the Library model has no `oldLibraryId` (it was just written to `extraData`), so the key is "undefined" and old library ids in users' `librariesAccessible` are mapped to undefined and dropped.
- server/objects/files/LibraryFile.ts `setDataFromPath`: `getFileTimestampsWithIno` returns `false` when stat fails; the file is then created with `ino` undefined and no size/timestamps, and no error is reported.
- server/auth/TokenManager.ts `rotateTokensForSession`: when the conditional update hits 0 rows and the session row has been deleted in the meantime, `findOne` returns null and `updatedSession.refreshToken` throws.
- server/auth/OidcAuthStrategy.ts `verifyCallback`: when no user matches and auto-register is off, `user.isActive` is read on null and throws a TypeError, so the intended 'User not active or not found' error is never thrown (the login still fails, the log shows the TypeError).
- server/routers/ApiRouter.ts `getUserListeningStatsHelpers`: reads `s.lastUpdate`, but PlaybackSession has no `lastUpdate` (it is `updatedAt`), so `items[id].lastUpdate` is always undefined.
- server/models/Collection.ts `getOldCollectionsJsonExpanded`: the permission-filtered books are assigned to `this.books`, which in this static method is the Collection class, not the collection `c`; `c.toOldJSONExpanded()` then uses the unfiltered `c.books`, so users with tag or explicit-content restrictions get every book of a collection they can see (and the class gets a stray `books` property).
- server/models/Library.ts `getMaxDisplayOrder`: `this.max('displayOrder') || 0` applies `|| 0` to the promise, which is always truthy, so with no libraries it resolves to null instead of 0.
- server/models/Author.ts `getAllLibraryItemsForAuthor`: `author.books` is read without checking that `findByPk` found the author, so an unknown author id throws a TypeError.
- server/models/Feed.ts `updateFeedForEntity`: when the library item, collection or series of the feed no longer exists, `getExpandedById` returns null and `getFeedObjFor...` throws a TypeError before the try block (3 places), so the caller gets an exception instead of null.
- server/models/Playlist.ts `checkHasMediaItem`: without an episodeId it reads `pmi.mediaItem.libraryItem.id` for every item, but a podcast episode media item has no `libraryItem` (it is on `episode.podcast`), so it throws a TypeError for playlists that contain episodes.
- server/models/PodcastEpisode.ts `createFromRssPodcastEpisode`: RSS chapters can have `end: null` (the RSS parser types them so), and they are stored in the `chapters` column, which everything else reads as chapters with a numeric end.
- server/models/LibraryItem.ts `saveMetadataFile`: the podcast branch writes `asin: mediaExpanded.asin`, but Podcast has no asin, so it is always undefined (and left out of metadata.json).
- server/models/User.ts `checkCanAccessLibraryItem`: `libraryItem.media.metadata?.explicit` reads a property of the old models; Book and Podcast have no `metadata`, so that half of the explicit check is always false.
- server/models/Session.ts `refreshToken` (with server/auth/TokenManager.ts `createTokensAndSession`, `rotateTokensForSession`): the column is NOT NULL, but TokenManager writes `generateRefreshToken` results, which are null when signing fails; the create/update then fails validation and throws instead of reporting the signing error.
- server/managers/NotificationManager.ts `onTest`: calls `triggerNotification('onTest')` without event data; `getApprisePayload` then reads the template variables from undefined and throws a TypeError for the default onTest templates (`{{version}}`). onTest is not called anywhere at the moment.
- server/managers/CronManager.ts `checkUpdatePodcastCron`: the log title falls back to `libraryItem.media.metadata?.title`, an old-model property; Podcast has no `metadata`, so the fallback is always undefined.
- server/managers/RssFeedManager.ts `checkFeedRequiresUpdate`: when the library item, collection or series of a feed no longer exists, `getEntity` returns null and the next read throws a TypeError (2 places); `getFeed`: when `updateFeedForEntity` returns null, `feed.buildXml` throws a TypeError.
- server/managers/PodcastManager.ts `createPodcastsFromFeedUrls`: when `getFileTimestampsWithIno` fails (returns false), the library item is created with `ino` undefined and the timestamps 0; when the feed title is empty or not a string, `sanitizeFilename` returns false, so the podcast path ends in "/false" and `relPath` is false.
- server/managers/CoverSearchManager.ts `startSearch`: on a failed search it calls `onError(error.message)`, but onError takes (provider, errorMessage), so the client gets the message as the provider and an undefined error.
- server/managers/MigrationManager.ts constructor: the default `configPath = global.configPath` reads a global that is never set (the global is `ConfigPath`); Database passes the path, so the default is not used.
- server/scanner/MediaProbeData.ts `setData`: prober accepts a file with only a video stream; `audio_stream` is then null and the reads of `this.audioStream` throw a TypeError, which prober.probe returns as the error (so the AudioFileScanner "no audio stream" message is not used for such files).
- server/scanner/AudioFileScanner.ts `getTrackAndDiscNumberFromFilename`: reads `author` and `series` from the filename metadata, which has `authors` and `seriesName`, so the author and series are never removed from the filename; `partbasename.replace(publishedYear)` has no replacement, so the year is replaced with the string "undefined".
- server/scanner/PodcastScanner.ts `saveMetadataFile`: writes `asin: libraryItem.media.asin`, but Podcast has no asin, so it is always undefined (same as LibraryItem `saveMetadataFile`).
- server/scanner/LibraryItemScanner.ts `getLibraryItemScanData`: when `getFileTimestampsWithIno` fails (returns false), the scan data gets `ino` undefined and the timestamps 0.
- server/scanner/Scanner.ts `quickMatchLibraryItem`: `PodcastFinder.search` returns null for a podcast without a title, and `results.length` then throws a TypeError.
- server/scanner/LibraryScanner.ts `scanLibrary`: when a library item is removed while the scan runs, `getExpandedById` returns null and the null is pushed to the updated items and emitted to clients (`items_updated`).

## Log
### Batch 1: server/utils (46 files, all converted, none skipped)
- New type files: `server/utils/types.ts` (shared utils types, `declare global` for the `global.*` values used in utils, and typed views of untyped vendored libs/models), `server/utils/parsers/types.ts`, `server/utils/queries/types.ts`, and `server/utils/ssrf-req-filter.d.ts` (ssrf-req-filter has no types; tsconfig excludes `*.d.ts`, so it is pulled in with a `/// <reference>` from `server/utils/types.ts`).
- devDependencies added (rule 10): `@types/express`, `@types/xml2js`, `@types/uuid`. They were already in node_modules as extraneous packages; `npm install` also pruned the other extraneous ones locally (`@types/passport`, `@types/cookie-parser`, `@types/express-session`, `@types/passport-strategy` ...), so later batches must add those to devDependencies when they need them.
- No files outside server/utils were changed (apart from package.json/package-lock.json and this file). No tests were changed.
- Module style: every module now ends in `export = <object/class/function>`. Modules that used `module.exports.x = ...` export one object literal with the same keys; checked that no utils module is in a require cycle, so assembling the export object at the end is safe. Internal `this.x()` / `module.exports.x()` calls go through that object, so sinon stubs on exports keep working. Compared `Object.keys`/`typeof` of every compiled module against HEAD: identical, except `parseFullName` is now a `function` declaration (needed for overloads) instead of an arrow function, so it has a `prototype`.
- Typed views for untyped JS (each a single commented `as` where the module is required): `FsExtra` for libs/fsExtra (its fs API is built at runtime), `ArchiverFactory` for libs/archiver, `SortInstance` for libs/fastSort, the fuse.js constructor in podcastUtils, ffprobe in prober, libarchive in comicBookExtractors.
- `TypedDatabase` (utils/types.ts): the JS models override `Model.init` with a different signature, so TypeScript rejects their static query methods (`findAll`, `count`, ...). Files that query cast `require('../../Database')` to `TypedDatabase` (same object; model getters still read lazily). It also types `sequelize` as set and `libraryFilterData`. Batch 3 (models) should make this unnecessary.
- Model associations (`book.libraryItem`, `series.bookSeries`, `mediaProgress.mediaItem`, ...) and JSON columns (`user.permissions`, `user.extraData`, `playbackSession.mediaMetadata`) are not declared on the JS models; the queries describe the loaded rows locally and cast once per query result. Sequelize's types are stricter than what it accepts at runtime (arrays of where options, `limit: null`, `[literal]` order items, a single nested include object, `distinct` on findAll, `limit` on count); those option objects use `QueryFindOptions` or are cast at the call with a comment.
- Behaviour-neutral code changes made for typing: `new Date() - n` became `new Date().valueOf() - n` (same coercion); a few repeated reads were pulled into a commented local (`permissions`, `mediaMetadata`, `models`); `getMediaGroupQuery` in libraryItemsBookFilters writes properties through a `mediaWhereHash` alias of the same object; `libraryFilters.getFilterData` replaces its sets with arrays through a typed alias of the same object; zipHelpers no longer requires express at runtime (it was only used for a JSDoc type); dbMigration no longer destructures the unused `QueryInterface` value from sequelize.
- JSDoc in not yet converted JS files that points at typedefs which moved (`import('../utils/fileUtils').FilePathItem`, `import('../utils/podcastUtils').RssPodcast*`, `import('./parseEbookMetadata').EBookFileScanData`) now resolves to `any` in those JS files; point them at `server/utils/types.ts`, `podcastUtils.ts` or `parsers/types.ts` when those files are converted.
- Incremental tsc crash: changing `server/utils/types.ts` (its `declare global` block) makes `tsc` crash with `Debug Failure. False expression` in `getSpecifierForModuleSymbol` while re-emitting signatures of JS files. A clean build works; fix with `rm dist-server/.tsbuildinfo`.
- Result: `npm run build:server` reports 0 `error TS`; `npm test` 356 passing, 0 failing.

### Batch 1 fixes (after independent review)
- abmetadataGenerator: restored the original `validated.series?.length` truthiness check (the batch had changed it to `Array.isArray(...) && ...length`); `series` is now typed `unknown[]` instead of using an `as`.
- Class fields declared without an initialiser in comicBookExtractors, utils/index (ValidationError, NotFoundError), rateLimiterFactory and longTimeout compiled to `field;` lines that created own properties set to undefined. They are now `declare` fields (rule 12) and compile to nothing, as in the JavaScript.
- Tried `"useDefineForClassFields": false` in tsconfig.server.json first and reverted it: it changed the compiled output of 21 files, including about 10 JS files that are not converted yet (ApiCacheManager, Database, Logger, TokenManager, MigrationManager, BinaryManager, User, DeviceInfo, ServerSettings, BookScanner), where real field initialisers move into the constructor body after parameter defaults. 13. Batch 3 is split in two.

The models must declare their JSON columns (permissions, extraData, mediaMetadata, libraryFiles) and their associations (for example book.libraryItem, series.bookSeries), and must type size, mtime and ctime as they really are at runtime.     - b: Sequelize or Express typing limitation

    - d: other

15. Banned shortcuts. Do not use:

    - function types with `never` parameters
    - `null as unknown as T`. If the JavaScript assigns null or checks for null, declare the field `T | null` and handle null where it is used, without changing behaviour. If the JavaScript never initialised the field, use `declare x: T` (rule 12).

/**
 * Types shared by the library query helpers in server/utils/queries.

import type { OrderItem, WhereAttributeHash } from 'sequelize'
import type Sequelize = require('sequelize')
import type LibraryItem = require('../../models/LibraryItem')
import type Feed = require('../../models/Feed')

/**
 * Named replacements for the raw SQL literals in a query
 */
export type QueryReplacements = Record<string, unknown>

/**
 * Where options and replacements used to restrict items to what a user can access
 */
/**
 * One where condition: an attribute hash or a Sequelize.where(...) condition
 */
export type WhereItem = WhereAttributeHash | ReturnType<typeof Sequelize.where>

export interface UserPermissionPodcastWhere {
  podcastWhere: WhereItem[]
  replacements: QueryReplacements
}

export interface UserPermissionBookWhere {
  bookWhere: WhereItem[]
  replacements: QueryReplacements
}

/**
 * Where options and replacements for a media filter group
 */
export interface MediaGroupQuery {
  mediaWhere: Record<string, unknown>
  replacements: QueryReplacements
}

/**
 * Library item model returned by the filter queries, with the properties the queries attach to it
 */
export type FilteredLibraryItem = LibraryItem & {
  feeds?: Feed[]
  rssFeed?: Feed
  numEpisodesIncomplete?: number
  recentEpisode?: unknown
  [key: string]: unknown
}

/**
 * User permissions JSON column (only the fields read by the queries)
 */
export interface UserPermissions {
  accessAllTags?: boolean
  itemTagsSelected?: string[]
  selectedTagsNotAccessible?: boolean
  accessExplicitContent?: boolean
}

/**
 * Find options as the query helpers build them. Sequelize accepts these at runtime but its types are stricter
 * (arrays of where options, a null limit, single nested include objects, [literal] order items),
 * so they are cast to the sequelize options type where they are passed to a model.
 */
export interface QueryFindOptions {
  where?: unknown
  replacements?: QueryReplacements
  include?: unknown
  attributes?: unknown
  order?: unknown
  limit?: number | null
  offset?: number
  distinct?: boolean
  subQuery?: boolean
  benchmark?: boolean
  logging?: (sql: string, timing?: number) => void
}

type Literal = ReturnType<typeof Sequelize.literal>

/**
 * Order item as the queries build them. Sequelize also accepts an item with only a literal (which holds the direction)
 */
export type QueryOrderItem = OrderItem | [Literal]

/**
 * Include options as the queries build them (see QueryFindOptions)
 */
export type QueryInclude = Record<string, unknown>

Batch 3c is finished and committed. `grep` now finds no match for `QueryFindOptions` in server/ (it found 31 before). The clean build reports 0 `error TS`, `npm test` shows 356 passing and 0 failing, and no test was changed. One thing needs your decision: casts to `FindOptions` come to 11, which is over rule 17's limit of 10 (details below).

**Commit 1: `phase3: fix batch 5 and 6 notes` (634aeaba)**
- Added your sentence to the "Batch 5 and 6" Log entry, under "By target type".
- Tagged the cast in `AudioFileScanner.ts`: `// cast(d): FileMetadata types filename and path as string | null, but scanned and stored files always have both`. The code is unchanged.
- The build and tests were green before this commit.

**Commit 2: `phase3 batch 3c: replace QueryFindOptions` (bef5fe3d)**
- **New type:** `RuntimeFindOptions` in `server/utils/queries/types.ts`. It takes `FindOptions`, leaves out where, attributes, limit, include and order, and adds them back in the shapes Sequelize accepts at runtime:
  - where, attributes and limit may be null
  - a nested include may be a single object
  - order items may be `[literal]`
  - `distinct` is allowed

  Every other option keeps its Sequelize type, and nothing is `unknown` or `any`.
- **`QueryInclude`:** this type already existed as `Record<string, unknown>`. It is now the include part of the same type, built from Sequelize's `IncludeOptions` with the same relaxed options. No other shared type was added.
- **Call sites:** the casts on option variables are now a plain `as FindOptions` or `as CountOptions` instead of `as unknown as`. The 11 inline option literals are now checked with `satisfies RuntimeFindOptions`, which produces no JavaScript. Before, they were not checked at all.
  - 3 of those literals still need `as unknown as`, because TypeScript won't compare their nested single include objects with `FindOptions` directly. The `satisfies` check still applies to them.
  - One count call passes `col`, so it is checked against `RuntimeFindOptions & Pick<CountOptions, 'col'>`, written inline rather than as a new type.
- **One local type annotation:** in `libraryItemsPodcastFilters`, `podcastEpisodeWhere` is now typed `WhereAttributeHash | WhereAttributeHash[]`. Its old type was only accepted because `where` used to be `unknown`.
- **Compiled JS:** I built HEAD and this change and compared every server file with comments removed. They are identical; only 38 comment lines differ, so no compiled line to list.
- **Cast counts** (whole server, excluding libs):

  | | `as` | `as unknown as` | `!` |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Before | 567 | 164 | 170 |
  | After | 582 | 149 | 170 |

  No cast was added or removed. 18 existing casts changed, all now tagged b: 15 went from `as unknown as` to plain `as`, and 3 stay `as unknown as`.
- **MIGRATION.md:** I added a note to row 3 of the Progress table and marked item 1 of the batch 11 checklist as done. I also marked the batch 3b Known deviations entry as done and added a "Batch 3c" Log entry. No bugs were found, nothing was skipped and nothing new was added to Known deviations.

**Decision for you:**
- **Rule 17:** by target type, the changed casts are `FindOptions` 11, `FindAndCountOptions` 4 and `CountOptions` 3. These 11 are the casts that were already at each model call. I can't remove them without changing the calls or the queries, because Sequelize's model methods only accept `FindOptions`. I committed and recorded it in the Log instead of stopping; tell me if you'd rather handle it differently.

**Left alone, noted in the Log for batch 11:**
- In `libraryFilters` `getFilterData`, the first `as CountOptions` isn't needed: the build is clean without it. I only reworded its comment and kept the cast.
- 15 other `as unknown as Includeable` or `FindOptions` casts in models, scanner, managers, userStats and ApiRouter never used `QueryFindOptions`. They may be able to use the new types, but I haven't checked them one by one.
